STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_02848_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_02848_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_02848 (
	CLOCK,
	I2C_SCLK,
 	I2C_SDAT,
	I2C_DATA,
	GO,      
	END,     
	W_R,     
	ACK,      
	RESET,
	
	SD_COUNTER,
	SDO
);
	input  CLOCK;
	input  [23:0]I2C_DATA;	
	input  GO;
	input  RESET;	
	input  W_R;
 	inout  I2C_SDAT;	
	output I2C_SCLK;
	output END;	
	output ACK;
	output [5:0] SD_COUNTER;
	output SDO;

	reg SDO;
	reg SCLK;
	reg END;
	reg [23:0] SD;
	reg [5:0] SD_COUNTER;

	wire I2C_SCLK = SCLK | ( ((SD_COUNTER >= 4) & (SD_COUNTER <= 30)) ? ~CLOCK : 0 );
	assign I2C_SDAT = SDO ? 1'bz : 1'b0;

	reg ACK1, ACK2, ACK3;
	assign ACK = ACK1 | ACK2 | ACK3;

	always @(negedge RESET or posedge CLOCK) begin
		if (!RESET) 
			SD_COUNTER = 6'b111111;
		else begin
			if (GO == 0) 
				SD_COUNTER = 0;
			else if (SD_COUNTER < 6'b111111) 
				SD_COUNTER = SD_COUNTER + 1;	
		end
	end

	always @(negedge RESET or posedge CLOCK) begin
		if (!RESET) begin 
			SCLK = 1;
			SDO = 1; 
			ACK1 = 0;
			ACK2 = 0;
			ACK3 = 0; 
			END = 1; 
		end
		else begin
			case (SD_COUNTER)
				6'd0  : begin ACK1 = 0; ACK2 = 0; ACK3 = 0; END = 0; SDO = 1; SCLK = 1; end
				6'd1  : begin SD = I2C_DATA; SDO = 0; end
				6'd2  : SCLK = 0;
				6'd3  : SDO = SD[23];
				6'd4  : SDO = SD[22];
				6'd5  : SDO = SD[21];
				6'd6  : SDO = SD[20];
				6'd7  : SDO = SD[19];
				6'd8  : SDO = SD[18];
				6'd9  : SDO = SD[17];
				6'd10 : SDO = SD[16];	
				6'd11 : SDO = 1'b1;
				6'd12  : begin SDO = SD[15]; ACK1 = I2C_SDAT; end
				6'd13  : SDO = SD[14];
				6'd14  : SDO = SD[13];
				6'd15  : SDO = SD[12];
				6'd16  : SDO = SD[11];
				6'd17  : SDO = SD[10];
				6'd18  : SDO = SD[9];
				6'd19  : SDO = SD[8];
				6'd20  : SDO = 1'b1;
				6'd21  : begin SDO = SD[7]; ACK2 = I2C_SDAT; end
				6'd22  : SDO = SD[6];
				6'd23  : SDO = SD[5];
				6'd24  : SDO = SD[4];
				6'd25  : SDO = SD[3];
				6'd26  : SDO = SD[2];
				6'd27  : SDO = SD[1];
				6'd28  : SDO = SD[0];
				6'd29  : SDO = 1'b1;
				6'd30 : begin SDO = 1'b0; SCLK = 1'b0; ACK3 = I2C_SDAT; end	
				6'd31 : SCLK = 1'b1; 
				6'd32 : begin SDO = 1'b1; END = 1; end 
			endcase
		end
	end
endmodule
